newsitem.title: USA: U.S. blue chips rise before May jobs report.
newsitem.headline: U.S. blue chips rise before May jobs report.

text.p: Blue-chip stocks rose Thursday in a surprising show of investor confidence ahead of Friday's widely awaited May employment report.

Based on early, unofficial results, the Dow Jones industrial average rose 35.63 points to close at 7,305.29, after rising as much as 82 points earlier. In the broader market, advancing issues led declines by about a 3-2 margin on volume of about 456 million shares on the New York Stock Exchange. The Nasdaq composite index rose 10.14 points to 1,389.81.
